name: useBatteryShare
summary: Google Pixel Battery Share (reverse wireless Qi charging) state and toggle.
plain: Shows whether the phone's reverse wireless charging coil is on and tries to switch it. It cannot tell whether a receiver is docked or how much power flows.
description: Reads the Google Pixel reverse charging sysfs node (/sys/class/power_supply/wireless/reverse_chg_mode, or /sys/devices/platform/google,battery/reverse_chg_mode): a non-zero mode means the coil is on. setBatteryShare writes that node when the app is permitted to and reports whether the write succeeded. Receiver presence, delivered watts and a charge cutoff are not exposed by any node PixelKit can read, so the hook reports none of them (transmittedWatts is always null) and offers no threshold setting.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether a readable reverse charging sysfs node exists on this device.

returns.name: isActive
returns.desc: Whether the node reports the reverse charging coil as on (non-zero mode).

returns.name: transmittedWatts
returns.desc: Real-time power transmitted in watts (W), or null if inactive/unsupported.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if reading or toggling the coil failed.

returns.name: setBatteryShare
returns.desc: Writes the reverse charging node on or off and re-reads it; false when the app may not write it.

returns.name: refresh
returns.type: () => { isSupported: boolean; isActive: boolean; transmittedWatts: number | null; error?: string | null } | null
returns.desc: Re-reads the reverse charging node and returns what was read, or null when the read failed or the native module is absent.

actions.name: setBatteryShare(enabled)
actions.desc: Writes the reverse charging node on or off, then re-reads it.
actions.output: Resolves true when the node write succeeded, false when the app may not write it. isActive afterwards is the re-read node value, not the request.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Re-reads the reverse charging node and returns what was read, or null when the read failed or the native module is absent.

agentNote: Works only on Pixel devices that expose a reverse_chg_mode sysfs node the app can read. Never show a receiver, wattage or cutoff value: the hook reports none (transmittedWatts is null). setBatteryShare resolves true only when the node write succeeded; apps usually cannot write it, and then the answer is false.
